items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: His mother is Charlotte Fillmore... Whenever Clark Terry or Zoot Sims or a lot of other musicians come to Washington, they go straight to Charlotte Fillmore's house... I am going to call her soon and talk to her... I pick her up at the airport and I go over to see Charlotte.

ctx.x: So anyone, Osie and I were very good friends. His mother is Charlotte Fillmore, who is the darling of a lot of musicians in New York right now. Clark Terry...
